_comment: Questions whose reference answer (law position 30.04.2025) may not hold under the law in the corpus (April 2026). Built from scripts/thesis/law_change_check.py (corpus amendment footnotes) plus a web check of the Finance Act 2025/2026 and the 22.09.2025 rate/exemption notifications; see docs/law_changes_2025_2026.md. status: affected = the answer changes under the corpus law; possibly = depends on facts or on a commencement date; the other questions using amended provisions were checked and are unaffected.

87621bos-aps2102-p5u3_q006.note: IGST s.13(8)(b) (intermediary services: place of supply = location of supplier) was omitted by the Finance Act 2026 w.e.f. 30.03.2026. Under the corpus law the place of supply is the recipient's location (s.13(2)), so ABC Pvt. Ltd.'s service can qualify as an export of service - the reference answer ('not an export') reflects the law as on 30.04.2025 only.

88087bos-aps2102-ch6_q003.note: s.15(3)(b) was substituted by the Finance Act 2026 (from a date to be notified; one secondary source calls it operational): a post-supply discount no longer has to be agreed before the supply - a credit note plus ITC reversal by the recipient suffices. Case (iii) (credit note after re-valuation) would then be excludable. The corpus already shows the new text.

88087bos-aps2102-ch6_q010.note: Same s.15(3)(b) substitution. The outcome likely stays (April-June: ITC not reversed -> no deduction; July-September: reversed -> deduction), but the reasoning 'agreement at or before supply, linked to invoices' is the old text.

88886bos-aps2102-m2-p7_q021.note: Notification 16/2025-CT(R) exempts individual life and health insurance from 22.09.2025. If the 'life insurance policies for specified employees' are individual policies, no GST is charged and there is no ITC to take; group policies stay taxable. The answer (ITC available via the s.17(5)(b) proviso) holds for 30.04.2025.

88886bos-aps2102-m2-p7_q023.note: Same as p7_q021: life insurance for specified employees - exempt from 22.09.2025 if individual policies, so the ITC line would be nil.

88886bos-aps2102-m2-p7_q022.note: Health insurance of factory employees: taxable if a group policy (outcome unchanged); exempt from 22.09.2025 if individual policies.

88886bos-aps2102-m2-p7_q020.note: Health insurance for excavator operators: same 22.09.2025 exemption caveat (individual vs group policy).

88886bos-aps2102-m2-p7_q018.note: Health insurance policies for specified employees: same 22.09.2025 exemption caveat.
